basis: The governance page says the Verein Ein Haus WOBA, based in Basel, constituted itself in July 2017 and is led by a three-person Vorstand.
The information page says the Association Villa Le Lac Le Corbusier has managed the museum since 1 January 2013.

Page 6 of the 2025 annual report says the Rudolf Steiner Nachlassverwaltung, which runs the archive in Haus Duldeck, was an association for about 70 years and a foundation with a Stiftungsrat since 2015.
The sponsor page says Turn End Trust is a registered Charitable Incorporated Organisation, CIO No 1162076.

Pages 19 and 20 of the 2024/25 Trustees' Annual Report give the National Trust for Scotland's constitution (Acts of 1935 to 1973 and 2013, Scottish charity SC007410, board partly elected by members), page 12 says all employees are employed by the Trust and page 26 says the Board approves the budgets; the report names the Hill House among the Trust's restoration projects.
The Charity Commission register entry for charity 271185 gives the governing document as a trust deed dated 8 March 1976.
The Isokon story page says the gallery is a registered charity, The Isokon Gallery Trust, charity number 1161069.
Companies House lists The 78 Derngate Northampton Trust as a private company limited by guarantee without share capital, and the house's about page gives Registered Charity no. 1068270.
Page 2 of the June 2023 New York State Education Department memo to the Regents says LongHouse Reserve is an education corporation chartered by the Board of Regents (provisional 2002, absolute 2013).
